name: HeyGen
description: HeyGen creates videos with AI avatars and voices, with credit-based plans from a free plan to Business and Enterprise.
features: Lip-sync translation and Video Agent (limited trial access on Free)
Export up to 4K on Pro and Business
strengths: Free plan with no card required
Credits roll over for one month on paid plans
limitations: Free videos carry a watermark, up to 1 minute each
Total monthly video minutes per plan are not stated

plans.name: Pro
highlights: Higher credit tiers up to 100,000 credits at $4,300 per month

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Extra team members cost $20 per seat per month

free.details: 3 videos per month with a watermark, up to 1 minute per video, one Custom Video Avatar, 30+ languages. No credit card needed.

api.summary: API pricing is linked from the page but no figures were shown.

pricing.regional: Currency shown only as '$'. Tax and regional pricing: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. For Individuals, Monthly view: Free $0 (3 watermarked videos/month, 1 minute each); Creator $29/month (600 credits, 1080p, no branding); Pro $49/month (1,000 credits, 4K, videos up to 30 minutes). A Yearly toggle ('2 months free') exists. The For Businesses tab was not re-read, so Business $149 is from an earlier check.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Make videos from text with AI avatars, voices and translation

capabilities.title: Generate a video from a prompt
capabilities.text: Video Agent creates a video from a text prompt, with motion graphics and other elements still editable afterwards.

capabilities.title: Present with an avatar
capabilities.text: Choose an avatar, enter a script, pick a voice and language, then generate and export.

capabilities.title: Translate existing videos
capabilities.text: Translate into 175+ languages and dialects with voice cloning, lip-sync and a brand glossary.

capabilities.title: Turn a deck into video
capabilities.text: PPT/PDF to Video makes each slide a scene with an avatar and voiceover.

featureCards.name: Avatar V
featureCards.text: Keeps an avatar's identity consistent across videos, with lip-sync, gestures and several camera angles.

featureCards.name: AI Studio
featureCards.text: A text-based editor where you control script, tone, gestures and emotion.

featureCards.name: Team tools
featureCards.text: Comments, tagging, multi-user editing, Brand Kit, auto captions and B-roll.

featureCards.name: Other ways to start
featureCards.text: Text to Video, Image to Video and Audio to Video.

featureCards.name: Custom avatars with verification
featureCards.text: A custom avatar needs on-camera identity verification from the person shown.

featureCards.name: Moderation
featureCards.text: The platform scans for policy violations and includes moderation.

scenarios.title: Translate a video for new markets
scenarios.text: Keep the speaker's voice and re-sync the lips in another language.

scenarios.title: Turn a podcast into a video
scenarios.text: Convert audio into video with an avatar.

scenarios.title: Make an onboarding video
scenarios.text: Start from a script and export a finished training video.

scenarios.title: Send personalised sales outreach
scenarios.text: Create videos tailored to a prospect.

gettingStarted.text: The site says a free plan supports text-to-video and AI-generated video creation.

gettingStarted.step: Choose an avatar and add a script
gettingStarted.text: Or upload a deck, or a short clip or image to use yourself as the avatar.
